title: Reach Aggregation Spec v1
description: Attestation-graph-aggregated reach level for content-node subjects. Counts qualifying attestations across four kinds (gate-decision, witness, endorsement, content-approval) within a one-year rolling window and maps the total to one of four reach tiers: protocol (≥50), public (≥20), community (≥5), or self-reach (below 5). Used by reach-gate-v1 to determine the audience tier a content node has earned through distributed recognition.
content:
# reach-aggregation-v1
# See gate-client/src/dag/specs/reach_aggregation_v1.json for the canonical embedded source.
# This seed entry makes the reach aggregation spec discoverable as a ContentNode on the DHT.
#
# The authoritative JSON is embedded in the gate-client binary at compile time.
# This seed is a reference copy for DHT-based governance lookup (Phase 6+).
#
# Threshold-ladder tiers:
#   protocol  (≥50) — existential-boundary peers
#   public    (≥20) — open audience endorsement
#   community (≥5)  — known community recognition
#   self-reach (<5) — default; content accessible only to contributors
#
# Attestation kinds feeding this aggregation:
#   gate-decision   — a gate verdict referencing this content node
#   witness         — a seven-valence witness attestation on an associated experience-story
#   endorsement     — an explicit peer endorsement attestation
#   content-approval — a steward-consent approval attestation

specName: "reach-v1"
version: "1.0.0"
subjectScope: content-node
timeWindow: P365D
outputShape: ReachLevel
